description.zh: 被禁言的用户列表。多个用半角逗号（,）隔开，最多不超过30个。
description.en: A list of users to mute. Separate multiple user IDs with a comma (,). You can specify a maximum of 30 users.

description.zh:
数据中心，需要与[CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~)中的数据中心一致。
> 当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）。
description.en:
The data center. This must be the same data center that you specified when you called the [CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~) operation.

> Currently, this operation is supported in Shanghai (value: cn-shanghai) and Singapore (value: ap-southeast-1).

descriptions.zh:
调用本接口前，您必须已经调用[CreateLiveMessageGroup](~~2848163~~)创建互动消息群组。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Before you call this operation, you must call the [CreateLiveMessageGroup](~~2848163~~) operation to create an interactive message group.

## QPS limit

The queries per second (QPS) limit for this operation is 10 calls per second for each user. API calls that exceed this limit are throttled, which may affect your business. Plan your calls accordingly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live add-live-message-group-band --app-id demo --group-id grouptest --banned-users uid1 --data-center cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live AddLiveMessageGroupBand --region cn-hangzhou --DataCenter 'cn-shanghai' --AppId demo --BannedUsers uid1 --GroupId grouptest
